m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: What's your beef with us? You're looking for the Head Constractor? He's over there in the Constractors' Depot. Now, be gone with ya!
Hey! You think you can bumble about and just bust in here...? Wait. Is that Snake Plizkin? Well, I'll be coiled in a knot. Thought you was dead.
Yeah, well, join the club, pal. If I hadn't busted out of that blasted Prison you built, I probably would be.
Is that so? Speaking of you busting out... that's been a bit of a bother. Kobra Kommander's had us slaving away ever since trying fix things.
Funniest part is... we still haven't figured out how you escaped. Don't suppose you wanna tell us? Fine. I guess we'll beat it out of you.
Hold back, you brutes! Much as I'd like to see you battered and bruised, I know when I'm beat. Kobra Kommander's gonna be mighty mad though.
Good. Tell that traitorous coward Snake Plizkin's still around, and he hasn't forgotten his old friend. We'll cross paths again, he and I.
Check it out. Looks like the Prison Blueprints right over there. Let's get 'em and move on, before Kobra Kommander sends his Elite Vipers.
Here. Let me have a look. I'll study the Blueprints on the way back to your Mongu friend. Hopefully, I can make some sense of them.
Finally you found the Blueprints! Well done! Now we just have to find a way into the Prison, rescue the Hairkonnen girl and escape again. Easy.
We must persist in our cause. After all, somewhere down in the bowels of that heinous prison, an innocent Qhat is all alone.
Do I look discouraged? Misfortune's my middle name. The day my luck turns around will probably be my last, so don't worry about me.
We just have to find this Head Constractor Isibore. That means we'll have to knock around some Boa Constructors. Won't be easy.
I don't know. I suspect this Wizard can handle almost anything. We shall see, won't we? Good luck. I will wait here.
Beware the Boas, Wizard. They may be less venomous than their Viper Overseers, but their strength more than makes up for it.
